> "We shrank the buttons, banished the chaotic emojis, and slapped fingerprint scanners on the logout button because someone thought they could outsmart parental controls." 😎

---

### What We Cooked Up

- **Smartwatch & Tiny Screen Rescue**: If you're running ScreenHarmony on a watch or a screen built for ants, rejoice. The keypad, PIN dots, and dialogs no longer play hide-and-seek off the edges of your display. Everything fits, scrolls, and actually behaves now. 🤩
- **The Great Emoji Eviction**: We gently escorted random emojis out of the UI and replaced them with crisp, dignified Material icons. The app finally looks like software made by adults. 🙂
- **Biometric Padlock on Logout**: Trying to sneakily unlink a device or wipe the database? Nice try. It now demands your fingerprint or face before letting anyone touch the reset switch. 🫡
- **Brand New Parenting Dashboard**: Rebuilt the landing page into two clean, sleek cards that actually sync colors with your system Material theme. 🥳
- **Hardened Pairing Handshake**: Devices now negotiate pairing like seasoned diplomats with auto-retry loops and an instant offline alert so you're never left staring into the void wondering if Wi-Fi died. 😅
- **Account Creation Wizard**: 3-step setup with live username availability checks and a one-tap backup for your 12-word recovery phrase so you don't end up locked out. 🧐

---

*Take it for a spin and let us know if anything catches fire.* 😀
